title: The Pink Jet Set Holiday Shopping Outfit
description: A pink and camel holiday shopping outfit, all from Walmart: a pink Michael Kors Jet Set crossbody, a Scoop pink crewneck sweater, a Time and Tru trench, Levi Strauss Signature flare jeans, Celebrity Pink lug booties and a cream cable knit beret.
intro: Holiday errands don't need a whole new wardrobe. They need one good outfit you can throw on and walk out the door in. This one is pink and camel, warm enough for a cold main street, and the pink Jet Set crossbody does all the heavy lifting. A soft pink sweater, a classic trench left open, flare jeans, black lug booties that can handle a slushy parking lot, and a cream cable knit beret because it's December and we're allowed.

sections.heading: The bag
paragraphs: The Michael Kors Jet Set Signature Logo Small Shoulder Crossbody in Carnation: pink logo print with a smooth pink top panel, gold hardware and an adjustable strap. Small enough for a wallet, phone and keys, big enough to look like you tried.

sections.heading: The layers
paragraphs: The Scoop Women's Crewneck Seam Sweater in pink, the Time and Tru Women's Double-Breasted Trench Coat in Mandalay Brown with its tie belt, and the Levi Strauss Signature Women's High Rise Flare Jeans in a medium wash.

sections.heading: The finishing touches
paragraphs: Celebrity Pink Women's Grasia Lug Booties in black for the cold sidewalks, and the Time and Tru Women's Cable Knit Beret in off-white.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The entryway, the street, the shopping bag and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, color and size before you buy.
